label: Text Preview
description: Show a text that may be long to a model without spending its budget: put it between any tool whose output can be long (a shell command's output, a fetched page, rows) and the model. It keeps the text's start, its end, or both with the middle cut (`keep`, `both` by default), within `maxLines` lines and `maxChars` characters, whichever runs out first; a single line longer than that is cut too. With `both`, the start gets `startShare` of each budget and the end the rest. Where something was cut, a line in its place says how much, like `[... 4556 of 4812 lines cut (198312 of 210004 characters), from the middle ...]`, and `cut` is true. Give it `text`, or a stored text `file` (read as UTF-8 as it streams, so a file of gigabytes costs no more memory than the preview). To see another part, the model changes its command rather than this node: `grep` for a pattern, `sed -n '100,200p'` for lines 100 to 200, `tail -n 50` for the end.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The text to preview. Give this or `file`, not both.

inputs.name: file
inputs.label: File
inputs.description: A stored text file to preview, read as UTF-8 (a byte that is not UTF-8 reads as �). Give this or `text`, not both.

inputs.name: keep
inputs.label: Keep
inputs.description: `start` keeps the start and cuts the end, `end` keeps the end and cuts the start, `both` keeps the start and the end and cuts the middle.

inputs.name: maxLines
inputs.label: Max lines
inputs.description: The most lines the preview shows.

inputs.name: maxChars
inputs.label: Max characters
inputs.description: The most characters the preview shows, at most 16000 so the preview always fits the 100 KB a wire carries.

inputs.name: startShare
inputs.label: Start share
inputs.description: With `keep` set to `both`, the share of both budgets the start gets (rounded down), the end getting the rest. Ignored otherwise.

outputs.name: preview
outputs.description: What the reader should see: the whole text when it fits, the kept parts with a line in the cut's place saying how much was cut otherwise. An empty text previews as `(empty)`.

outputs.name: cut
outputs.description: True when part of the text was cut.

outputs.name: lines
outputs.description: Lines in the whole text (a last line without a line break counts).

then.message: TextPreview '{id}' is given both `text` and `file`: give the text one way.
